'''Weapons''' in Matcha Flavoured are the sword, the [[spear]] and the [[claymore]], plus the axe (see [[Tools]]), bows and a few special weapons. Alloy weapons carry intrinsics: shakudo steals life, electrum wards the undead, adamant weakens targets for [[Doom]], and steel adds knockback.

=== Special weapons ===
* [[Hatchet]] (Bloodrage), [[Cleaver]] (Slaughter), [[Crook]].
* [[Silver Sword]], [[Warding Sword]] and [[Warding Shield]] (see [[Warding]]).
* [[Compound Bow]], [[Mace]], [[Trident]]. Bows, crossbows and shields keep their vanilla recipes.
